name: nightscout-librelink-up-uploader
description: From: https://github.com/timoschlueter/nightscout-librelink-up "Script written in TypeScript that uploads CGM readings from LibreLink Up to Nightscout. The upload should work with at least Freestyle Libre 2 (FGM) and Libre 3 CGM sensors." This container will upload LibreLink Up (FreeStyle Libre 2/3) CGM data to your NightScout instance. Prerequesites: - Working NightScout instance - NightScout subject and access token for this uploader (https://github.com/timoschlueter/nightscout-librelink-up/issues/64#issuecomment-1252018083) - LibreLink Up follower account already setup. I'd recommend you create a new follower just for this uploader, you risk locking up your account temporarily while you troubleshoot any problems with the uploader's configuration. Ask me how I know. Notes: - The access token must be hashed with SHA1 (you can use https://codebeautify.org/sha1-hash-generator).

variables.name: LibreLink Up Username
variables.description: This will be the account email for your LibreLink Up follower account, NOT your LibreView account.

variables.name: LiberLink Up Password
variables.description: This will be the password for your LibreLink Up follower account, NOT your LibreView account.

variables.name: LibreLink Up Region
variables.description: Your region. Used to determine the correct LibreLinkUp service (Possible values: AE, AP, AU, CA, DE, EU2, EU2, FR, JP, US)

variables.name: LibreLink Up App Version
variables.description: This may need to be updated if you are using a newer version of the LibreLink Up App

variables.name: Disable NightScout HTTPS
variables.description: Change to true if you're running a local instalation of NightScout wihout https

variables.name: Single Shot
variables.description: Will execute once and close. Useful to troubleshoot problems with the configuration.

variables.name: All Dta
variables.description: Upload all available data from LibreLink Up instead of just data newer than last upload. LibreLinkUp sometimes lags behind in reporting recent historical data, so it is advised to run the script with ALL_DATA set to true at least once a day.
